meta.title: SAP MDG (Master Data Governance): vendor created/updated in Procol
gaps: Configure integration INT-001 with its SAP MDG endpoint, OAuth credentials, sync mode, and batch size.
Configure CONF-VM-002 mandatory vendor document types.
Create or update a vendor in Procol with name, PAN, GSTIN, bank details, vendor code, status, and category.
Observe or verify that the SAP MDG/Oracle external system received or returned the vendor data.
Compare the vendor master fields between Procol and the external system.
Verify that no integration error was recorded for the synchronization.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure integration INT-001 with its SAP MDG endpoint, OAuth credentials, sync mode, and batch size.; Configure CONF-VM-002 mandatory vendor document types.; Create or update a vendor in Procol with name, PAN, GSTIN, bank details, vendor code, status, and category.; Observe or verify that the SAP MDG/Oracle external system received or returned the vendor data.; Compare the vendor master fields between Procol and the external system.; Verify that no integration error was recorded for the synchronization.

steps.note: Set the stated bidirectional synchronization gate before attempting the trigger.

args.need: configure the SAP MDG integration and mandatory vendor document types, create or update the vendor in Procol, compare all listed vendor master fields with the external SAP MDG system, and verify that no integration error was recorded

steps.note: These integration, vendor-master, external-system, and cross-system comparison actions are not available in the catalog.
Check that the current Procol screen has no visible application or server error after the tester-assisted work.
